questions.question: What ID do I need to bring?
answer_facts: Every guest aged 18 or over shows a government photo ID on arrival
Aadhaar card, passport, driving licence or voter ID
PAN cards are not accepted as ID for check-in

questions.question: hey, do i need a visa to stay?
answer_facts: Every foreign guest (any age) shows their passport and valid Indian visa
We are required to submit a Form C registration to the immigration authorities
Overseas Citizens of India (OCI) cardholders still need Form C registration

questions.question: I’m traveling with my younger sibling and want to know if we can stay together, just the two of us.
answer_facts: Guests under 18 must stay with a parent or legal guardian who is on the booking
We can't accept bookings where every guest is under 18

questions.question: What happens to my ID details after check-in?
answer_facts: ID details are used only for the legal registration above
kept as long as the law requires
We don't share them for marketing
